name: Twitch
note: Twitch's Help Center has no dedicated article documenting video-player keyboard shortcuts (searched help.twitch.tv for 'keyboard shortcuts', 'hotkeys', and 'video player controls'; none exists as of 2026-09-04). The player-control shortcuts below (Play/Pause, Mute, Captions, Theatre Mode, Fullscreen, skip-to-content) were instead taken directly from the accessibility tooltips (aria-label/title text) built into twitch.tv's own player and site chrome, which is the only place Twitch documents them. Shortcuts widely repeated by third-party sites (J/L or Left/Right arrow seek by 5-10 s, comma/period frame-step, Up/Down arrow volume) could not be confirmed against any official Twitch source or the live player's own tooltips and were left out per the no-invention rule. Also skipped: 'Hold Alt to pause chat' (a hold-state tied to an opt-in Chat Settings toggle, not a discrete keypress the chord grammar can express) and plain Up/Down arrow navigation of the @mention autocomplete suggestion list (generic textbox autocomplete behavior, not a distinct product shortcut). Chat reply shortcuts are current as of the Chat Basics article's last revision (9 Jul 2026).
